answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils the way a zephyr is forced through a single gate: every identity must lock a jade-grade stake in a shared escrow thread, forfeited if the same operator is caught running duplicate accounts. The stake is cheap for one honest agent but multiplies with each extra identity, so a farm of a thousand fakes must fund a thousand stakes. Independent auditors scan the escrow thread for shared keys, hardware fingerprints or payment trails and slash any identity linked to another, making fake identities costly to create and cheap to expose.
